title: French Tomato Gratins
description: A delightful French-inspired side dish featuring juicy tomatoes baked in a creamy gratin. Perfect for accompanying your favorite meals.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the crushed tomatoes, chopped basil, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Transfer the tomato mixture to 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place a slice of brie cheese on top of each tomato mixture.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with additional basil if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve warm, garnished with additional basil if desired.
